title: Happy Birthday, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Symbol of best wishes Wonderful idea for an elegant gift Adorned with multicolored digital printing Sometimes a well-chosen gift can express more than 1,000 words. The „Birthday” Coin is the perfect way to celebrate a special day. Meticulously crafted with a unique design, it becomes a remarkable gift that will remind you of those magical moments for a lifetime. Give a loved one a coin that symbolizes joy and new beginnings.
